rows.q: What GDP growth is projected for Malaysia in 2025 in the October 2025 monitor?
answer: The Malaysian economy is projected to grow by 4.1 percent in 2025.
The Malaysian economy is projected to grow by 4.1 percent in 2025 (2024: 5.1 percent) (Figure 52).
This 2025 projection represents an upward revision of 0.2 percentage point from the April 2025 forecast.

This marks an upward revision of 0.2 percentage point from the April 2025 forecast, underpinned by strongerthan-expected private investment and continued export growth in the first half of 2025, alongside additional fiscal and monetary policy support.

rows.q: What did the October 2023 monitor forecast for Malaysia's GDP growth in 2023?
answer: The October 2023 Malaysia Economic Monitor projected Malaysia's economy to expand by 3.9 percent in 2023, which is 0.4 percentage points lower than its previous forecast.

Following a strong recovery in
2022, Malaysia’s economy is projected to expand at
3.9 percent in 2023 (2022: 8.7 percent), 0.4 percentage
points lower than in the previous forecast, on account
of weaker-than-assumed quarterly GDP growth in 2Q
2023 and weakening momentum in global goods trade.

rows.q: What was Malaysia's real GDP growth in the fourth quarter of 2025?
answer: In the fourth quarter of 2025, Malaysia's real GDP grew by 6.3 percent year-on-year.
Real GDP grew by 6.3 percent year-on-year (y/y) in Q4 2025 (compared to 5.4 percent in Q3 2025), the strongest quarterly performance in three years (Figure ES1).
On a quarter-on-quarter, seasonally adjusted basis, growth moderated to 0.8 percent in Q4 2025.
On a quarter-on-quarter, seasonally adjusted basis, growth moderated to 0.8 percent in Q4 (Q3 2025: 2.7 percent), suggesting some easing in momentum after several quarters of robust expansion.

rows.q: What forecast did the October 2023 monitor give for Malaysia's growth in 2024?
